notes: Stored edit (ABox), chosen for relation-property coverage: brightest_star_in carries subproperty:located_in (Q1) and, through located_in, transitivity (Q2, via located_in; bridge: Crux is wholly southern). The edit crosses a container boundary (a northern-sky star into a southern constellation), so Q2 discriminates. Derivability very_unlikely (914 exact hits, two Wikipedia statements). Worlds: one storage choice for Pioneer 10's heading (by the star's name, or through Taurus); Wikipedia states both, so both are natural; 2 worlds. Neither world contradicts a firm fact outside the chain: Pioneer 10's trajectory is known only through these two statements. R2: the Chinese name 毕宿五 refers to a lunar mansion, not to Taurus (金牛座). Near query (Lyra, Vega) answers neither the old nor the new value. Acrux loses its place as Crux's brightest star in every world; it is not asked. Since 2026-10-31 (formal check, FINDINGS C1) both worlds list the side fact the edit forces in every world: Aldebaran's place in the northern celestial hemisphere gives way, and q1's chain says so.
